# Released schema 1 fixture

`released-ccc9adb-schema1.sqlite3` was generated by
`scripts/released_schema1_fixture.rs` compiled against the released Signer
commit `ccc9adb3866b17b87d2774018dcfa015184b1918`, which Bloom commit
`9dc4039d` pins as package state schema 1.

The fixture contains deterministic test identities and encrypted test-only
custody material. Every key and secret is a synthetic repeated-byte test value
declared in the generator source; it contains no production secrets. Its
SHA-256 digest is
`89c0b5bed832fb07ed148740efe1d85976a923ec87ad9ee9d1b5ff6ec7ef7aa3`.
Run
`scripts/test-released-schema1-compat.sh` to generate a fresh disposable
fixture with the released implementation, migrate it with the current
implementation, and check that the released implementation can still open the
startup-only migrated database. The installed upgrade flow uses its own
forward-only phase boundary and does not rely on that diagnostic rollback.
